info.title: rust-web-dashboard
info.description: Standalone Rust web dashboard for a DCS-gRPC server (single-binary axum + tonic)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Carrier group name (defaults to `CVN-72`). Ignored when `names` is given.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description:
Comma-separated carrier group names. When present the response is
`{ "reports": { <name>: <report> } }` and costs one mission Eval for all of them.

200.description: Current carrier telemetry and recovery solution (one report with `name`, `{ reports }` with `names`)

404.description: Carrier group not found in the mission (single-name form only)

400.description: Invalid action or carrier group name

404.description: Carrier group not found in the mission

409.description: Recovery already active (start) or not active (resume)

422.description: Recovery leg unsafe (land clearance) or circuit could not be restored

200.description: Every carrier-type ship group in the running mission

400.description: Invalid carrier group name or target out of range

post.summary: `POST /api/auth` — exchange the admin password for a session JWT.

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/auth` — logout. JWTs are stateless, so this is a client cue.

get.summary:
`GET /api/auth/callback` — complete the OAuth flow and redirect to the UI
with a session token in the URL fragment, or an error query on failure.

303.description: Redirect to UI with token or error

get.summary: `GET /api/auth/discord` — redirect the browser to Discord's OAuth consent.
`GET /api/auth/verify` — confirm a bearer token is valid.

get.description:
Intentionally public so the login screen can surface server status before a
session exists. Process liveness lives at `GET /healthz`.

500.description: Failed to connect to DCS server

get.summary:
`GET /api/logs/access` → authentication audit log, mapped to the frontend
shape (`timestamp` ms / `userId`).

parameters.name: since_id
parameters.description: Only return passes with an id greater than this (incremental polling).

404.description: LSO_DIR not configured or lso.db not created yet

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Passes to keep per pilot, newest first (default 5, max 2000).

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: `true` returns every pass for every pilot and ignores `limit`.

200.description: Passes grouped by pilot, newest pilot first

404.description: LSO_DIR not configured or lso.db not created yet

get.summary:
`GET /api/mission` → current mission + paused state (HookService) plus
filesystem-derived `serverInfo`, `queue`, and `uploadedMissions`.
get.description:
Per-call gRPC failures fall back to `"Unknown"` / `false`, matching the
source's individual `.catch(...)` handling. A `serverSettings.lua` parse
failure yields `serverInfo: null` and an empty queue, as in the source.

post.summary:
`POST /api/mission` → mission control actions (HookService). Queue
mutation (`add_to_queue` / `remove_from_queue`) is filesystem-backed and
returns `501` until Phase 5.

get.summary:
`GET /api/mission/browse` → recursively list `.miz` files under `Missions`
(depth ≤ 3, skipping hidden folders and `Uploads`).
`GET /api/server/dcs-process` → check if DCS.exe or DCS_server.exe is running.
`GET /api/server/services` -> list status of configured Windows services.

`GET /api/settings` → parsed `serverSettings.lua` (flat object with the
`advanced` block, `missionList` array, and primitive keys).

post.summary:
`POST /api/triggers` → set user flag (TriggerService.SetUserFlag). The
source coerced `flag` via `.toString()` and `value` via `Number(...)`.

get.summary:
`GET /api/weather` → presets + current applied weather state. Overrides the
reported mission name with the live DCS mission when reachable.

post.summary: `POST /api/weather/apply` → run the weather generator and reload the mission.

AirbossActionResponse.description: Result of `start` / `resume`. `status` returns the controller's status table instead.

AirbossCarrier.description: One carrier-type ship group detected in the mission.

attributes.description: DCS attributes that decided the classification.

deck_offset.description: Angled-deck offset the controller uses for this hull, degrees.

group.description: Mission Editor group name (what every other airboss call takes).

target_wod.description: Target wind over deck currently in force for this group, knots.

type.description: DCS unit type name of the lead ship (e.g. `CVN_72`, `LHA_Tarawa`).

version.description: Version of the Lua controller that answered.

target_wod.description: Target wind over deck for this ship, knots (10 to 45).

AirbossDataResponse.description:
Telemetry and recovery solution for one carrier group, as returned by the
Lua controller's `windReport`.

angled_deck_min_wind.description: Below this natural wind the ship keeps its course and only adjusts speed.

backend.description: `foothold` when the Foothold BattleCommander manages this group, else `standalone`.

carrier_name.description: Mission Editor group name of the carrier.

carrier_u.description: Ship position, DCS map coordinates (x north, z east).

coalition.description: Coalition of the group (0 neutral, 1 red, 2 blue).

deck_class.description: Deck classification: `catobar`, `stobar`, `vstol`, `unknown`, or absent for a non-carrier ship.

deck_offset.description: Angled-deck offset used for this ship type, degrees.

headwind.description: Headwind component of the natural wind on the current course, knots.

recovery_heading.description: Course the controller would steer for a recovery, degrees true.

recovery_speed.description: Speed the controller would order for a recovery, knots.

ship_spd.description: Current ship speed over ground, knots.

target_wod.description: Target wind over the angled deck the controller aims for, knots.

tw_dir.description: Natural wind at deck height: direction it blows from, degrees true.

type_name.description: DCS unit type name of the lead ship (e.g. `CVN_71`).

wod.description: Wind over deck on the current course, knots.

AirbossReportsResponse.description:
Batched telemetry: one entry per requested group name. A ship that is not
in the mission gets `{ "error": "<name> is not available." }` instead.

LsoPass.description:
One recorded pass, mirroring the LSO client's `StoredPass` minus
`pilot_ucid`. Field names match `/api/passes` of the LSO client so the page
logic ports one to one.

lso_notes.description: Plain-English translation of `dcs_grading`, computed at query time.

timestamp.description: File stem of the pass artifacts, `LSO-<date>-<pilot>-<recovery-id>`.

LsoPilot.description:
One pilot's slice of the board for `/api/lso/pilots`.

Pilots are identified by their DCS UCID when the rows carry one, so a pilot
who renames keeps a single history; rows without a UCID (legacy databases,
AI pilots) are grouped by name. The UCID itself never leaves the server.

aliases.description: Other names seen on this pilot's earlier passes (same UCID).

avg_points.description: Mean project score over `graded_passes`, or null when none were scored.

graded_passes.description: Passes that carry a project score (`points_awarded` not false).

passes.description: Newest first, truncated to the requested per-pilot limit.

pilot_name.description: Name on the pilot's newest pass.

total_passes.description: Every pass on record for this pilot, independent of the per-pilot limit.

LsoPilotsResponse.description: `/api/lso/pilots` payload. Pilots are ordered by their newest pass.

per_pilot_limit.description: Per-pilot cap that was applied; null means every pass was returned.
